knowledge:
- key_parameters: fdr=The target False Discovery Rate to maintain (e.g., 0.05) ;; coef=The coefficient or contrast to test in limma or edgeR ;; name=The name of the individual coefficient to test in DESeq2 ;; step=The step size for testing fold changes (e.g., 0.05 for speed, 0.01 for precision in practice) ;; trend=Set to TRUE in limma_confects if not using voom or precision weights to account for a mean-variance trend ;; cooksCutoff=Set to Inf in deseq2_confects to disable outlier filtering if a complete ranking of all genes is desired ;; independentFiltering=Set to FALSE in deseq2_confects to disable independent filtering if a complete ranking of all genes is desired
- alternatives: limma::treat=Requires a pre-specified fold change cutoff, whereas topconfects automatically ranks genes by the largest confident fold change at a given FDR ;; topTable/topTags=Rank genes by p-value/FDR, which can act as a proxy for evidence quality rather than biological effect size ;; DESeq2::lfcShrink=Provides shrunken LFC estimates but does not indicate significance (can produce non-zero values for non-significant genes), whereas topconfects returns NA for genes that are not significantly non-zero
- when_to_use: Use as the final step of a differential expression analysis (RNA-seq or microarray) using limma, edgeR, or DESeq2 to rank genes by confident effect size rather than statistical significance alone.
- pitfalls: Do not use confects_plot_me as it overlays estimated and confident effect sizes in a way that is confusing and easily misleading; use confects_plot_me2 instead ;; Only quasi-likelihood testing from edgeR (glmQLFit) is supported ;; DESeq2 filters some genes by default, placing them at the bottom of the table with NA confect values; disable this with cooksCutoff=Inf and independentFiltering=FALSE if a complete ranking is needed ;; Using a large step size (e.g., 0.05) is fast but less precise; use a smaller step (e.g., 0.01) in practice

workflows.name: limma_confects
workflows.intent: Rank genes by confident fold change from a limma linear model fit.
workflows.stages: 1. Fit linear model using voom and lmFit ;; 2. Calculate confident effect sizes using limma_confects ;; 3. Visualize results using confects_plot and confects_plot_me2
workflows.code:
fit <-
    voom(y, design) %>%
    lmFit(design)
confects <- limma_confects(fit, coef="Treathrcc", fdr=0.05)
confects_plot(confects)
confects_plot_me2(confects, breaks=c(0,1,2))

workflows.name: edger_confects
workflows.intent: Rank genes by confident fold change from an edgeR quasi-likelihood fit.
workflows.stages: 1. Estimate dispersions and fit QL model ;; 2. Calculate confident effect sizes using edger_confects ;; 3. Visualize results using confects_plot and confects_plot_me2
workflows.code:
y <- estimateDisp(y, design, robust=TRUE)
efit <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust=TRUE)
econfects <- edger_confects(efit, coef="Treathrcc", fdr=0.05, step=0.05)
confects_plot(econfects)
confects_plot_me2(econfects, breaks=c(0,1,2))

workflows.name: deseq2_confects
workflows.intent: Rank genes by confident fold change from a DESeq2 analysis.
workflows.stages: 1. Create DESeqDataSet and run DESeq ;; 2. Calculate confident effect sizes using deseq2_confects ;; 3. Visualize results using confects_plot
workflows.code:
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = arab,
    colData = data.frame(Time, Treat),
    rowData = arab_info,
    design = ~Time+Treat)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
dconfects <- deseq2_confects(dds, name="Treat_hrcc_vs_mock", step=0.05)
confects_plot(dconfects)
